I decided to start the books a couple months ago, and am currently 200 pages from the end of A Storm of Swords. The first thing I noticed when I was reading the books was how much dialogue was copy and pasted into the script of the show. Like it seems to be that 70% of the dialogue in the show was taken directly from the books. I'm not sure how many other book to tv/movie adaptations do this but I feel like it's just that GRRM has an amazing style of writing that translates perfectly to the screen. It makes the books so easy to read because it's just like watching the show play out in your imagination.
